# RequirementVerificationMembership <span class="sd-sphinx-override sd-badge sd-outline-primary sd-text-primary">SysML</span><a href="#requirementverificationmembership-sysml" class="headerlink" title="Link to this heading"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>

*<span class="pre">class</span><span class="w"> </span>*<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">RequirementVerificationMembership</span></span><a href="#syside.RequirementVerificationMembership" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Implementation of <span class="pre">`RequirementVerificationMembership`</span> defined in the SysML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> A <span class="pre">`RequirementVerificationMembership`</span> is a <span class="pre">`RequirementConstraintMembership`</span> used in the objective of a <span class="pre">`VerificationCase`</span> to identify a <span class="pre">`RequirementUsage`</span> that is verified by the <span class="pre">`VerificationCase`</span>.
>
> </div>

For language description, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/2a-OMG_Systems_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=176" class="reference external" target="_blank">7.24.2</a> of the SysML specification. For more details on the model, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/2a-OMG_Systems_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=408" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.24.2</a> of the SysML specification.

*<span class="pre">property</span><span class="w"> </span>*<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">owned_requirement</span></span>*<span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a href="/python/v0.8.4/syside/RequirementUsage.md" class="reference internal" title="syside.RequirementUsage"><span class="pre">syside.RequirementUsage</span></a><span class="w"> </span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\|</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="pre">None</span>*<a href="#syside.RequirementVerificationMembership.owned_requirement" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Implementation of <span class="pre">`owned_requirement`</span> defined in the SysML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> The owned <span class="pre">`RequirementUsage`</span> that acts as the <span class="pre">`owned_constraint`</span> for this <span class="pre">`RequirementVerificationMembership`</span>. This will either be the <span class="pre">`verified_requirement`</span>, or it will subset the <span class="pre">`verified_requirement`</span>.
>
> </div>

See section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/2a-OMG_Systems_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=409" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.24.2</a> of the SysML specification for more details.

*<span class="pre">property</span><span class="w"> </span>*<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">verified_requirement</span></span>*<span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><a href="/python/v0.8.4/syside/RequirementUsage.md" class="reference internal" title="syside.RequirementUsage"><span class="pre">syside.RequirementUsage</span></a><span class="w"> </span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\|</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="pre">None</span>*<a href="#syside.RequirementVerificationMembership.verified_requirement" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Implementation of <span class="pre">`verified_requirement`</span> defined in the SysML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> The <span class="pre">`RequirementUsage`</span> that is identified as being verified. It is the <span class="pre">`referenced_constraint`</span> of the <span class="pre">`RequirementVerificationMembership`</span> considered as a <span class="pre">`RequirementConstraintMembership`</span>, which must be a <span class="pre">`RequirementUsage`</span>.
>
> </div>

See section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/2a-OMG_Systems_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=409" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.24.2</a> of the SysML specification for more details.
